note: Sheet items the two blind readers gave different domains. Neither reader saw a stored domain. lead_ruling is filled when the lead rules.

first_reader.reason: A component of the external-coil vacuum field on a control surface, with its toroidal mean removed, is a magnetic geometry quantity rather than a plasma response.

second_reader.reason: A vertical external-coil field specified on a control surface is the field used for vertical position and shape control.

lead_ruling.reason: Other domains were checked first: magnetic_field_systems covers the coil hardware and excludes the field it produces, magnetohydrodynamics covers modes, and no domain names a non-axisymmetric vacuum field; it falls to equilibrium although it is not a Grad-Shafranov quantity.

first_reader.reason: A species ion density evaluated on the last closed flux surface is an ion density at a bulk-plasma profile locus, not a scrape-off-layer quantity.

second_reader.reason: Ion density on the last closed flux surface is a plasma-boundary, edge-region quantity.

lead_ruling.reason: A density on the last closed flux surface is an edge quantity.

first_reader.reason: A signed height of an annulus centre in the cylindrical frame is a geometry and coordinate-system definition.

second_reader.reason: The centre coordinate of a passive conducting annulus is machine field-hardware geometry.

first_reader.reason: A detector pixel's lower photon-energy bound in an X-ray crystal spectrometer is a setting of an emission-spectroscopy instrument.

second_reader.reason: The lower energy bound of an X-ray crystal spectrometer pixel is an X-ray detection property.

lead_ruling.reason: A setting of an emission-spectroscopy instrument.

first_reader.reason: A bias voltage setting the gain of one mass-spectrometer channel is generic diagnostic hardware rather than a plasma quantity.

second_reader.reason: The bias voltage of a mass-spectrometer channel sets the ion-signal gain of a species-resolving spectrometer.

lead_ruling.reason: Generic diagnostic hardware; a mass spectrometer is not optical spectroscopy.

first_reader.reason: The inclination angle of a plasma filament's cross-section describes the shape of an edge turbulent structure.

second_reader.reason: The cross-section orientation angle of a plasma filament is a scrape-off-layer filament geometry quantity.

lead_ruling.reason: A filament is plasma structure as modelled; neither reader chose this domain.

first_reader.reason: Current induced in an axisymmetric passive conducting loop is the passive stabilization response that vertical position control relies on.

second_reader.reason: Current in an axisymmetric passive loop is induced current in passive machine conductors.

lead_ruling.reason: Induced current in passive machine conductors.

first_reader.reason: A volumetric electromagnetic body force acting on plasma volumes and conducting structures is a force-balance quantity of MHD equilibrium.

second_reader.reason: Electromagnetic body-force density is the magnetic-force density of the plasma and conducting structures.

lead_ruling.reason: The body force is the force-balance term of the equilibrium.

first_reader.reason: A species ion density on the flux surface at the plasma boundary is a bulk-plasma profile value at the last closed flux surface.

second_reader.reason: Flux-surface-averaged ion density at the plasma boundary is an edge quantity.

lead_ruling.reason: A flux-surface average on the last closed flux surface is an edge quantity.

first_reader.reason: A traced field-line arclength during plasma initiation is startup-phase connection geometry.

second_reader.reason: The arclength of a traced field line is a magnetic geometry quantity.

lead_ruling.reason: Field-line arclength is magnetic geometry, not tied to the start-up phase.

first_reader.reason: The major radius of the closest wall point defines the plasma-wall gap in the equilibrium boundary description.

second_reader.reason: The major radius of the wall point nearest the plasma boundary is first-wall geometry.

lead_ruling.reason: The closest wall point defines the plasma-wall gap of the equilibrium boundary description.

first_reader.reason: An effective particle diffusivity relating a field-aligned flux to a parallel density gradient is a transport coefficient.

second_reader.reason: Parallel particle diffusivity of a species in the edge fluid model is an edge transport coefficient.

lead_ruling.reason: A diffusivity is a transport coefficient wherever it is evaluated.
